info.title: Solana Concepts Sandbox API
info.description: API documentation for dHealth<>Solana Sandbox concepts

get.summary: Retrieve system information
get.description: Retrieves system information including the appVersion.

get.summary: Retrieve program license
get.description: Retrieves program license.

get.summary: List all pets
get.description: Returns all pets from the database with their details.

post.description: Creates a new pet or updates an existing pet's information. Owner authorization required for updates.

ownerAddress.description: Solana wallet address of pet owner

get.summary: Get a specific pet by ID
get.description: Returns pet details including name, species, breed, age and owner information.

get.summary: Verify vaccination status for a pet
get.description: Returns all vaccinations recorded for a specific pet, including on-chain proof counts.

post.description: Records a new vaccination for a pet with optional transaction signature and hash for on-chain proof.

get.summary: Get nutrition plans for a pet
get.description: Returns all nutrition plans associated with a specific pet, including ingredients and SPL token information.

post.summary: Create a new nutrition plan with SPL token
post.description: Creates a nutrition plan for a pet with daily ingredient information. Creates SPL token mint and records on-chain via memo transaction. Pet owner authorization required.
Records a feeding action for a nutrition plan with on-chain memo transaction. Creates proof that pet was fed according to plan.

404.description: Nutrition plan or pet not found

post.description: Prepares an unsigned transaction for healthcare worker credential registration. User signs the transaction with their wallet, then submits to /register-verify endpoint.

200.description: Registration prepared - user should sign the transaction

post.description: Completes credential registration by submitting a user-signed transaction. Creates NFT mint and stores credential record in database.

signedTransaction.description: Base64 signed transaction from user's wallet

get.summary: List credentials
get.description: Returns all credentials.

get.description: Returns a credential by ID.

get.description: Returns a DID document by ID.

get.description: Returns certifications for a given credential ID.

get.summary: List credentials owned by wallet
get.description: Returns all credentials where the wallet is the owner. For authorized access to other wallets' credentials, use the files or authorized-signers endpoints directly with the credential ID.

get.summary: List all credentials accessible by wallet (owned and authorized)
get.description: Returns credentials where the wallet is either the owner or an authorized caregiver/signer.

isOwner.description: True if wallet is the credential owner, false if authorized signer

authorizedBy.description: Owner address (only present when isOwner is false)

get.summary: List files in a credential's uploads folder
get.description: Returns all files uploaded to a credential. Requires wallet to have access (owner or authorized signer).

403.description: Access denied - wallet not authorized for credential

post.summary: Upload a file to credential storage
post.description: Uploads a file to a credential's uploads folder. Requires wallet to have access. Includes file hash validation and size limits (5MB max).

fileBuffer.description: File content as base64 or Buffer

403.description: Access denied - wallet not authorized for credential

post.description: Authorizes a caregiver wallet address to sign transactions for a SAS Credential. Requires wallet to own or have access to the credential.

caregiverAddress.description: Solana wallet address of caregiver to authorize

403.description: Access denied - wallet not authorized for credential

get.summary: Get authorized signers for a credential
get.description: Returns list of wallet addresses that are authorized to sign with this credential. Requires wallet to have access to the credential.
